answers.core: Asking people to install a separate addon for your addon to just make your node _slightly_ easier for them to understand is a rather unnecessary step, at least in my opinion.
answers.workaround:
Unless if I somehow missed something glaringly obvious in the documentation, there's no way for me to add any hover-over descriptions in an alternative manner, unless if I do something like make a separate GDExtension to be bundled in with this addon, of which I think would be asking a bit much for just this rather simple functionality.

And yes, I'm aware of how you typically can just put `## Description here` above a variable to create a description, but this is not applicable here. This data is dynamically shoved into the properties to allow certain data to be assigned and then retrieved from a dictionary with `_get()` and `_set()` functions.

title: Allow dynamically generated properties in property lists to have hover-over descriptions.
